notes.title: VOICELINE UPDATE
notes.notes: [p]Hello,[/p][p][/p][p]After several weeks, the voiceline update is finally available![/p][p][/p][p]The main character is played by GodDoubleDamnit. Happy birthday to him![/p][p][/p][p]Other minor changes:[/p][list][*][p]Optimized the "SPAM E" menu[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the volume of some sounds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I haven't been very consistent lately, and I apologize for that. I'm working on the biggest project of my entire career, and it's taking up a lot of my time, but you'll hear about it soon on my Discord![/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p][p]TheCourget[/p]

notes.title: Announcement: THEBOAT release date delayed.
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm sorry to announce that THEBOAT is now delayed, I'm really sorry.[/p][p][/p][p]For a few weeks now I have no motivation to do anything, I really try but nothing comes to me, I just stare at an empty Unreal Engine project, for a few hours, to close it.[/p][p][/p][p]I will not give any more dates to avoid a possible delay in the future.[/p][p]When it comes out, you will be notified a few days in advance via a Steam and Discord post.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll really try to take time for myself, I will update SCHIZOPHRENIA, but less frequently.[/p][p][/p][p]The new VOICELINES update should be ready in a few weeks, I don't have any exact deadline.[/p][p][/p][p]I don't really know what to do now, I hyped people over a thing I've never finished, and I'm really sorry.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for everything, thank you for the support,[/p][p]I hope you're going to like THEBOAT (I'll post some sneak peeks on the Discord Server),[/p][p]TheCourget.[/p]

notes.title: VOICELINE UPDATE
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone ![/p][p][/p][p]In a few weeks, I am going to redo all the voicelines, and add missing ones.[/p][p]The voices will now be in French, my voice actors are French, the quality will be better ![/p][p][/p][p]I'm redoing dialogues for several reasons:[/p][list][*][p]Quality[/p][/*][*][p]I've cut ties with the voice actor "I", I won't say more on the subject for the moment.[/p][/*][*][p]The diversity of characters I could add (me, mom, dad, the doctor, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]AI is a poor alternative[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The update should be available in a few weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]I will show the progress on my official Discord, that you can join below ![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading this,[/p][p]TheCourget[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a graphics issue
- You can now pause the game with the controller pause button, and B (for Xbox Controllers)

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue with controller deadzone

notes.title: Controller Support Update Available !
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

I'm proud to announce that you can now play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a Xbox controller,
from the main menu to the game ending.

It took a few days but it's now here !

I also fixed some small things.

Next update should be audio update or Steam achievements update.

I hope you'll like to play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a controller.

Note : PlayStation controller support is not planned for now.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

notes.title: Controller Support Update Coming Soon.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !

I'm actually trying to release SCHIZOPHRENIA on consoles, but for now this is only an idea.
However, I think it can be cool to play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a controller.

The update should be uploaded in the week.

You can find more informations on the Discord server (link available in the game main menu or Steam page), there are also sneak peeks of a future project.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.
